ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var window = (attributes.queryParams.window default 14) var str = "P" ++ (window) ++"D" var today = now() as Date var start = (today - str) as Date --- { value: window, start: start, end: today }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, window: vars.window } --- buildLog("INFO","Trend Analysis Process Started",message,vars.correlationId, "orchestrate-trend-analysis-flow")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/json
var dateOfBirth = vars.userProfile.profile.dateOfBirth var age = do{ var today = now() as Date var dob = dateOfBirth as Date var rawAge = today.year - dob.year var passedBirthday = (today.month > dob.month) or (today.month == dob.month and today.day >= dob.day) --- if ( passedBirthday ) rawAge else rawAge - 1 } var primaryGoal = vars.userProfile.goals filter (item) -> item.isPrimary var condition = (vars.userProfile.conditions filter () -> $.isActive).conditionType var constraint = (vars.userProfile.constraints filter () -> $.isActive).constraintValue --- { "window": { "days": vars.window.value,"start": vars.window.start }, "profile": { "weightKg": vars.userProfile.profile.weightKg, "dailyCaloricTarget": vars.userProfile.profile.dailyCaloricTarget, "biologicalSex": vars.userProfile.profile.biologicalSex, "activityBaseline": vars.userProfile.profile.activityBaseline, "targetSleepDurationHrs": vars.userProfile.preferences.targetSleepDurationHrs, "age": age, "goalType": primaryGoal[0].goalType, "goalDirection": primaryGoal[0].goalDirection, "conditions": condition default [], "constraints": constraint default [], }, "meals": vars.mealStatus.meals, "foods": flatten(vars.mealStatus.foods), "sleepSessions": vars.wearableStatus.dailyData.sleep_sessions, "pointMetrics": vars.wearableStatus.dailyData.point_metrics, "workouts": vars.wearableStatus.dailyData.workouts, "baselineSummaries": vars.wearableStatus.baselineData.point_metrics }

logger.doc:name: Evaluation started
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, mealsLogged: vars.mealStatus.mealsLogged, nutritionResolved: vars.mealStatus.nutritionResolved, dailyDataAvailable: vars.wearableStatus.dailyDataAvailable, baselineAvailable: vars.wearableStatus.baselineAvailable, caloricTarget: vars.userProfile.profile.dailyCaloricTarget } --- buildLog("INFO","Evaluation started",message,vars.correlationId, "orchestrate-trend-analyis-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Evaluation Complete
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, windowDays: vars.window.value, mealLogDays: vars.evalResponse.coverage.meal_log.days_covered, wearableDays: vars.evalResponse.coverage.wearable.days_covered, daysRequired: vars.evalResponse.coverage.meal_log.days_required } --- buildLog("INFO","Evaluation complete",message,vars.correlationId, "orchestrate-trend-analyis-subflow")]

logger.doc:name: Trend Evaluation Complete
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json import buildLog from dwl::log var message ={ userId: vars.userId, windowDays: vars.window.value, recommendations: sizeOf(payload.recommendations default []), patternSignals: sizeOf(payload.pattern_signals default []) } --- buildLog("INFO","Trend response assembled",message,vars.correlationId, "orchestrate-trend-analyis-subflow")]
